notes: Retains V11.3 DRP, GNSS raw and Fusion Sensor independent position cards and dynamic four-point grid history.
Adds explicit DRP-GNSS, DRP-Fusion and GNSS-Fusion distance comparison when inputs are available.
Retains NMEA STW/Speed Log, OBD-II USB Vehicle Speed and Manual Test Speed sources in m/s.
Preserves existing VECTOR, SATELLITE, HYBRID and MARINE map modes unchanged.
Adds STREET, MARINE + STREET, MARINE + SATELLITE and MARINE + HYBRID display modes using the existing tile framework.
Street search/road routing UI is reserved for the next routing integration; no fake routing result is generated in this build.
